jobs.title: Healthcare Marketing (Sr.) Manager
jobs.company: 晨暉生物科技股份有限公司
jobs.desc: 1. Brand Architecture & Value Definition 品牌架構與價值定位 Establish the brand foundation by defining core values, visual identity, and communication tone from the ground up, ensuring a distinctive and professional positioning in the minds of consumers. 從零建立品牌基礎，包括 核心價值、視覺識別系統與品牌溝通語調，在消費者心中建立清晰、專業且具差異化的品牌定位。 2. Brand Storytelling 品牌敘事與溝通策略 Craft compelling brand narratives and translate complex scientific and R&D data into clear, engaging, and consumer-centric value propositions. 打造具吸引力的品牌故事，並將複雜的科學研究與研發數據轉譯為 清晰、易理解且以消費者為核心的價值主張，提升品牌溝通效果。 3. Product Concept & NPD Strategy 產品概念與新品開發策略 3.1 Market Opportunity Identification: Analyze industry trends and conduct competitive benchmarking to identify high-growth categories and define the strategic positioning of new products. 3.2 Product Concept Development: Lead product conceptualization, including formulation proposals, key selling points, packaging design, and pricing strategy. 3.3 ROI Assessment: Evaluate market potential and revenue projections (e.g., defining A+/A-tier product pipelines) to ensure effective allocation of resources. 3.1 市場機會識別: 分析產業趨勢並進行競品比較研究，識別高成長市場機會，並制定新產品的策略定位。 3.2 產品概念開發: 主導產品概念規劃，包括配方提案、核心賣點設計、包裝規劃與價格策略制定。 3.3 投資報酬評: 評估市場潛力與營收預測（例如建立 A+ / A 級產品管線），以確保資源配置與產品投資決策的有效性。 4. Cross-functional Leadership 跨部門協作與專案領導 4.1 Process Management: Drive Stage-Gate processes across product development, coordinating with R&D, regulatory, manufacturing, and commercial teams to accelerate time-to-market. 4.2 External Partnerships: Identify and manage external collaborations, including technology licensing, ingredient sourcing, and co-branding opportunities, to maximize brand impact. 4.1 流程管理: 推動產品開發的 Stage-Gate 管理流程，並與研發、法規、製造及商業團隊協作，加速產品上市時程（Time-to-Market）。 4.2 外部合作夥伴管理: 開發並管理外部合作機會，包括技術授權、原料合作夥伴及聯名合作等，以最大化品牌影響力與市場效益 。

jobs.title: 門市人員_全通路銷售顧問 (正職)  Omnichannel Sales Advisor (FT) [ 台北士林 DECATHLON]
jobs.company: Decathlon Taiwan_迪卡儂運動有限公司
jobs.desc: - 台北士林店籌備期間將在內湖、中和、三重培訓 - 工作目標/核心價值 透過提供獨特的全通路銷售體驗，並運用迪卡儂的經營基本原則，滿足顧客需求，讓人們享受運動的樂趣 專屬你的福利與優勢 (Your Exclusive Benefits) 在迪卡儂，我們支持你的生活與運動熱情！ 充電再出發： 滿一年即享 10 天年假,全薪傷病假 14 天 運動無負擔： 享有員工專屬購物折扣 ，以及享有運動裝備與運動活動津貼 獎勵與保障： 提供達標分紅獎金 、免費員工團體保險 ，以及每年免費員工健檢 友善環境： 永續通勤獎勵 社團生活： 多元社團與活動，讓你找到運動夥伴 ** 職責內容 (Key Responsibilities) 本職位包含三大核心職責，確保顧客獲得最佳的購物體驗： 1. 產品銷售與顧客服務 (Satisfy my customers by selling our products and services) - 展現服務熱忱，歡迎每一位顧客 。 - 在線上與實體通路銷售我們的產品與服務 。 - 向顧客推廣會員忠誠計畫 。 - 處理顧客付款事宜（門市結帳） 。 - 為顧客處理 Buyback 商品 。 2. 門市商業陳列與視覺動態 (Commercial and dynamic layout experience) - 遵循並執行商品陳列準則 (Merchandising guidelines) 。 - 確保商業排面完整 。 - 推動商業行銷活動 。 - 執行季節性商品調整與移動 。 3. 流程效率與庫存管理 (Process efficiency and stock availability) - 確保收貨至陳列的流程高效運作 (Truck to Peg process) 。 - 檢查庫存的準確性，並執行防止耗損計畫 。 - 管理試衣間並處理顧客退貨 。 - 準備「到店取貨(Click & Collect)」與「門市出貨(Ship from Store)」訂單 。 Core Value / Job Purpose To satisfy customer needs and enable people to enjoy the wonders of sport, by offering a unique omnichannel sales experience and applying Decathlon's business fundamentals. YOUR EXCLUSIVE BENEFITS At Decathlon, we support your life and passion for sport! - Recharge & Restart: Enjoy 10 days of annual leave after one year of service ; 14 days full-paid sick leave - Sporting Life: Exclusive employee discount on purchases, as well as allowances for sports equipment and activities. - Rewards & Protection: Providing profit-sharing bonuses for achieving targets, free employee group insurance, and annual free employee health checkups. - Eco-Friendly: Sustainable commuting bonus/incentive. - Community Life: Diverse clubs and activities to help you find your sports teammates. Key Responsibilities This role includes three core responsibilities to ensure customers receive the best shopping experience: 1. Product Sales and Customer Service (Satisfy my customers by selling our products and services) - Show availability and welcome each customer as a guest. - Sell our products and services physically and digitally (online and in-store). - Propose the loyalty program to customers. - Handle customer payments (Store Checkout). - Process Buyback products from customers. 2. Store Commercial Layout and Visual Dynamics (Commercial and dynamic layout experience) - Follow and apply merchandising guidelines. - Ensure a complete commercial facing (product presentation). - Put in place commercial campaigns. - Execute seasonal movings and adjustments. 3. Process Efficiency and Stock Availability (Process efficiency and stock availability) - Ensure an efficient truck to peg process (receiving to display). - Check stock for accuracy and apply the anti-shrinkage plan. - Manage fitting rooms and customer returns. - Prepare Click & Collect (C&C) and Ship from Store (SFS) orders.
